derivation: For minimally coupled clock levels E_n=m_n c^2, the physical heavy-source scattering energy is proportional to m_n. Taking the transition difference gives the same monopole potential per unit rest energy, so the r^-3 coefficient enters the clock ratio without an off-shell metric assignment.
contact_cancellation: source-self contact shifts are position independent for the same calibrated clock; source-clock cross contact is zero for disjoint supports
scope_guard: minimal point-clock monopole and adiabatic weak field; spin, tidal polarizability and apparatus-specific internal operators are separate finite-size effects
